messages:
elaine-partnerships: Quick sync - we reproduced OOMs on MI300 in eu-central during long-context evals (rebel-13b, seq 8192). Looks like KV cache growth, not model parameter overflow. Need contingency before Wed customer demos: marketplace fallback mapping + short SI test window + comms.

ken-eng: Copy. Minimal repro: `rebel-13b@v3` at seq 8192, batch 2. Log: `GPU OOM during KV-append`. Any temp flags?

vendor-mi300: We're on it. Reproduced locally. Tentative driver RC in 48-72h. Short-term: set `gpu_mem_guard=0.85` and avoid quantized builds for now.

sam-platform: Proposed mitigation: routing policy `mi300-eu-fallback` (canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%) that routes to H100/H200 hosts for that model tag. Also push an editorial marketplace suggestion so customers see fallback SKUs.

jules-cloud: I can prepare the marketplace non-breaking listing edit. Suggested mapping: `rebel-13b: eu -> [H100-XL, H200-STD]`. Hold until SI window confirmed.

vendor-gaudi: We'll run a 24h extended seq test for parity; send commit hash and we'll queue it. No regression seen so far on our images.

ken-eng: Add runtime soft-fallback rule: prefer H100 kernel for `seq_len>4096` for rebel-13b model id. Keeps most users unchanged. Also need perf/cost delta against H100 fallback for comms.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-345 created: "MI300 EU KV-cache growth / OOM". Runbook link: https://internal/redwood/incidents/INC-2026-345 (private).

sam-platform: Action list: 1) I'll open routing PR and marketplace draft. 2) @ken-eng will add runtime toggle & perf eval. 3) @jules-cloud will confirm SI window (Thu-Fri 02:00-08:00 UTC). 4) Vendors to supply RC and test reports. Reconvene in 48h or after RC. :thumbsup:
